CheckTitle: Security Groups with MySQL port (3306) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to MySQL port.
Risk: Exposing MySQL (3306) invites brute-force attacks, leading to unauthorized database access, data theft, and potential lateral movement into connected systems.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
